verdict.rationale: Docs show Fin can connect to external systems via the Fin Agent API, MCP server, webhooks, and helpdesk/CRM integrations (Salesforce, Zendesk, HubSpot) and can 'take action to update external systems,' which implies live-data lookups beyond static help articles, and this is corroborated by a live, auth-gated MCP endpoint and REST API. However, there is no first-party or independent evidence of a concrete example (e.g., pulling an order status or account history mid-conversation) proving this in practice, and one community voice argues deterministic tasks like order status are better handled by workflows than by an autonomous agent, raising doubt about how consistently live data is surfaced. Missing for 10: a documented case study or transcript showing Fin retrieving a customer's specific plan/order/account data in an answer, and independent confirmation this works reliably in production.
